counting_rule: documented uses against a satellite; deployment and construction do not count as use
source_page_or_section: SWF 2024 pp. 02-29 to 02-32 (2.4 Russian Directed Energy Weapons); Peresvet at 02-30, Kalina at 02-31
notes: Peresvet is a fielded mobile ground-based dazzler tied to protecting road-mobile ICBMs; Kalina is under construction at the Krona complex. No public record of either being used against a satellite. A fielded capability with a zero use rate is exactly the case the engine needs to represent.

counting_rule: one Nudol flight test = one event, including the one unconfirmed test, which is flagged in notes
source_page_or_section: SWF 2024 p. 02-19, Table 2-4 Nudol Flight Tests To Date
notes: Tests: 26 Mar 2018 (first from a mobile launcher), 23 Dec 2018, 15 Nov 2019, 15 Apr 2020, 16 Dec 2020, Apr 2021 (unconfirmed), 15 Nov 2021 (intercepted and destroyed Kosmos 1408 at ~470 km). Only the last was destructive: 1 destructive test in 7 years = 0.143/yr, and 1 of 7 flight tests. Two previously listed 2021 tests were removed in the 2024 edition after NOTAMs proved to be for postponed launches.
